verdict.rationale: Kick documents MCP and CLI connections for AI assistants, but the evidence describes them as granting 'full access to read and update your Kick data' or 'full control', with no scoped or least-privilege credential issuance for agents. Its role-based access control covers workspace members, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
